transcript.text: indesit oven stoped heating, fan goes round n light on but its stone cold after 20 mins. grill werks fine tho. any ideas b4 i call some1 out

The most common cause for a fan oven that blows air but stays cold is a failed fan oven element (the circular heater at the back). It could also be the function selector switch if it's not sending power to that element. Before calling an engineer, we can check the element visually. Please switch off the cooker at the wall and let it cool down completely. Look inside the main oven cavity at the back; you should see a circular metal element behind the fan. Are there any visible cracks, blisters, or holes in that metal tube? Also, check where the wires connect to it—are the ceramic insulators blackened or burnt?

ok isolated it at the wall n let it cool. took the back panel off (4 screws). theres a blister/split in the coil near the bottom with a black mark on it. also heard a little pop from in there last time it worked

[Heading: Failed fan oven element]
You will need to replace the fan oven element. Since this involves working inside an isolated mains appliance and handling electrical connections, if you are not confident doing this yourself, I would recommend calling a qualified engineer to fit the new part safely.

claimsRejected.claim: The fact that the fan runs and the grill works tells us you have power getting into the appliance, but the specific heating circuit for the main oven isn't activating.

claimsRejected.claim: That blister and the 'pop' you heard confirm it: your fan oven element has failed internally.
The split in the coil breaks the circuit to the heating part of the element, which is why the fan still runs (it's on a separate motor) but no heat is produced.
